# MetaBlooms Merkle Index (MBMI) — Spec v1

## Goal
Provide a cryptographic, incrementally-updatable index over MetaBlooms artifacts (chats, tasks, actions, BTS, gate packs, knowledge packs) to enable:
- Proof of coverage (what is indexed)
- Proof of provenance (what produced what)
- Deterministic reuse (skip recomputation when equivalent)

## Canonical layout
```
metablooms/index/
  roots/merkle_root.json
  nodes/node_<sha256>.json
  simhash/similarity.map.json
  reuse/reuse_registry.json
  coverage/domain_coverage.json
```

## Node types
- chat
- task
- action
- decision (BTS)
- artifact
- knowledge_pack

## Required fields (node)
- node_hash (sha256)
- type
- domain[]
- summary
- inputs[] (hashes)
- outputs[] (hashes)
- created_utc

## Root
`roots/merkle_root.json` contains:
- root_hash
